description: This file defines a custom exception class SavingsAccountClosingNotAllowedException used in the savings account closure process within the Fineract platform. It extends a base exception class and provides a specific error message key for handling closure restrictions.

classes.name: SavingsAccountClosingNotAllowedException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that closing a savings account is not allowed under certain conditions. It extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException and constructs a specific error message key based on the entity.

methods.name: SavingsAccountClosingNotAllowedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error key and message details, indicating that closing the account is not permitted.
